```{ojs}
// Load both locale trees once; missing French values fall back to English.
nbTextAll = {
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([
    FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/en.json").json(),
    FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/fr.json").json(),
  ]);
  return { en, fr: Lang.withFallback(fr, en) };
}

nbText = nbTextAll[language.key] ?? nbTextAll.en

nbTitle = nbText.meta.title

// Map CMS prose blocks explicitly because FileAttachment paths must be literals.
// English is embedded at build time; localized blocks support runtime switching.
proseFiles = new Object({
  "overview": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/overview.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/overview.fr.md") },
  "weather-measurement": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-measurement.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-measurement.fr.md") },
  "weather-consistency": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-consistency.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/weather-consistency.fr.md") },
  "forecast-reliability": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/forecast-reliability.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/forecast-reliability.fr.md") },
  "readiness-index": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/readiness-index.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/readiness-index.fr.md") },
  "hazard-intersection": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/hazard-intersection.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/hazard-intersection.fr.md") },
  "reach-at-scale": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/reach-at-scale.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/reach-at-scale.fr.md") },
  "methods": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methods.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methods.fr.md") },
  "data-sources": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/data-sources.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/data-sources.fr.md") },
  "methodology": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methodology.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/methodology.fr.md") },
  "acknowledgements": { en: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/acknowledgements.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/cis/text/acknowledgements.fr.md") },
})

// Load localized blocks in parallel for network-free toggles.
sectionsAll = {
  const load = (loc) =>
    Promise.all(
      Object.entries(proseFiles).map(async ([id, files]) => [
        id,
        Lang.parseBlock(await (files[loc] ?? files.en).text()),
      ]),
    ).then(Object.fromEntries);
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([load("en"), load("fr")]);
  return { en, fr };
}

sections = sectionsAll[language.key] ?? sectionsAll.en

// Language cells come from /components/_lang.qmd.
```

## Boundaries

```{ojs}
// Scope boundaries and queries to the same included countries.
import { getAdminBoundaries, iso3Set } from "/components/_atlasBoundaries.ojs";

import { adminBoundariesForSelection } from "/helpers/adminBoundaries.js";

// Levels 0 and 1 are small (14 KB and 48 KB over the wire) and always drawn.
atlasBoundaries = await getAdminBoundaries([0, 1]);

// Lazy-load and memoize admin 2 because it is only needed after region selection.
loadAdmin2Boundaries = {
  let pending = null;
  return () => (pending ??= getAdminBoundaries(2).then((b) => b.admin2));
}

// Fetch deep geometry only when drill-down needs it.
admin2Boundaries =
  selectedAdmin0.length && selectedAdmin1.length
    ? await loadAdmin2Boundaries()
    : null;

// Resolve drill-down once; maxLevel caps shallower datasets and turns deeper
// selections into highlights.
adminViewFor = (maxLevel) =>
  adminBoundariesForSelection({
    boundaries: { ...atlasBoundaries, admin2: admin2Boundaries },
    selection: {
      admin0: selectedAdmin0,
      admin1: selectedAdmin1,
      admin2: selectedAdmin2,
    },
    maxLevel,
  })

adminView = adminViewFor(2)

currentAdminLevel = adminView.level

currentBoundaries = adminView.boundaries

// Build join keys at the drawn admin level.
adminKey = adminView.adminKey

// Build highlight styling from the selection at this view's drawn level.
highlightFor = (view) => {
  const selected = view.selectedAtLevel;
  if (!selected) return null;

  const names = new Set(selected.names);
  return {
    filter: (feature) => names.has(feature.properties[selected.field]),
    stroke: "#000",
    strokeWidth: 2.5,
  };
}

adminHighlight = highlightFor(adminView)

// Share 3×3 legend geometry between both bivariate sections.
bivariateMapWithLegend = (map, { colors, yLabel }) =>
  html`<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
    <div style="flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; justify-content: center;">
      ${makeBivariateLegend({
        colors,
        xLabel: nbText.s3ReadinessLabel,
        yLabel,
        width: 220,
        height: 210,
        fontSize: 14,
      })}
    </div>
    <div style="flex: 1 1 640px; min-width: 0;">${map}</div>
  </div>`

// Narrow insight rows to selections at the view's drawn level.
onlySelectedAtLevel = (rows) => {
  const selected = adminView.selectedAtLevel;
  if (!selected) return rows;

  const names = new Set(selected.names);
  return rows.filter((row) => names.has(row[selected.field]));
}

// Null-safe fixed-point formatting.
fmt = (value, decimals = 3) =>
  value == null || Number.isNaN(Number(value))
    ? "N/A"
    : Number(value).toFixed(decimals)

// Use shorter table/export labels than map tooltips.
adminDisplayName = (d, level = currentAdminLevel) =>
  level === 0
    ? d.admin0_name
    : level === 1
      ? `${d.admin1_name}, ${d.admin0_name}`
      : `${d.admin2_name}, ${d.admin1_name}`;

// Estimate label width for Plot's left margin, then truncate at a proportional cap.
// Tooltips retain full labels.
labelAxis = (labels, chartWidth, { share = 0.35, minimum = 120 } = {}) => {
  const perChar = 7;
  const gutter = 12;
  // Avoid spreading thousands of admin-2 label lengths.
  const longest = labels.reduce((n, l) => Math.max(n, String(l).length), 0);
  const cap = Math.max(minimum, Math.round(chartWidth * share));
  const marginLeft = Math.min(cap, Math.max(minimum, longest * perChar + gutter));
  const fits = Math.floor((marginLeft - gutter) / perChar);

  return {
    marginLeft,
    tickFormat: (label) => {
      const name = String(label);
      return name.length > fits ? `${name.slice(0, fits - 1)}…` : name;
    },
  };
}
```
